require "/home/user/workspace/repo/bench/experiments/bmethod_census"
require "/home/user/workspace/repo/bench/experiments/fizzy_link_http"

app, state, mode = ARGV
if mode == "blog_prepare"
  ENV.update("RAILS_ENV" => "production", "SECRET_KEY_BASE_DUMMY" => "1", "LOWRAIL" => "0")
  require File.join(app, "config/environment")
  ActiveRecord::Schema.verbose = false
  %w[primary cache queue cable].zip(%w[schema cache_schema queue_schema cable_schema]).each do |connection, schema|
    ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(connection.to_sym)
    load File.join(app, "db/#{schema}.rb")
  end
  ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(:primary)
  stamp = Time.utc(2026, 1, 1)
  Article.insert_all!((1..3).map { |id| {id: id, title: "Article #{id}", body: "A sufficiently long body for validation.", created_at: stamp, updated_at: stamp} })
  Comment.insert_all!([1, 1, 2].each_with_index.map { |id, i| {id: i + 1, article_id: id, commenter: "Commenter #{i}", body: "A comment body.", created_at: stamp, updated_at: stamp} })
  puts "prepared 3 articles, comments 2/1/0, no callbacks"
  exit
end

BmethodCensus.start
if mode == "fizzy"
  FizzyLinkFixture.environment(app, state).each { |key, value| value ? ENV[key] = value : ENV.delete(key) }
  FizzyLinkFixture.boot(app)
else
  ENV.update("RAILS_ENV" => "production", "SECRET_KEY_BASE_DUMMY" => "1", "LOWRAIL" => "0")
  require File.join(app, "config/application")
  Rails.application.config.yjit = false
  require File.join(app, "config/environment")
end
Rails.application.eager_load!
BmethodCensus.snapshot
BmethodCensus.write(File.join(state, "boot.json"), BmethodCensus.report.merge(boot: "ok"))

observations = []
current = nil
request_thread = nil
methods = {}
trace = TracePoint.new(:call) do |event|
  next unless current && event.method_id && Thread.current.equal?(request_thread)
  key = [event.defined_class.__id__, event.callee_id, event.path, event.lineno]
  unless methods.key?(key)
    method = event.defined_class.instance_method(event.callee_id) rescue nil
    iseq = method && RubyVM::InstructionSequence.of(method)
    methods[key] = if iseq&.to_a&.fetch(9) == :block
      {name: event.callee_id, holder: BmethodCensus.label(event.defined_class), **BmethodCensus.shape(method)}
    end
  end
  next unless methods[key]
  current[:calls][key] += 1
end
wrapped = lambda do |env|
  counts = {route: env.fetch("PATH_INFO") + (env["QUERY_STRING"].empty? ? "" : "?#{env["QUERY_STRING"]}"), calls: Hash.new(0)}
  current = counts
  request_thread = Thread.current
  begin
    status, headers, body = trace.enable { Rails.application.call(env) }
    counts[:status] = status
    # Complete the Rack body while the observer is still in request scope.
    chunks = []
    trace.enable { body.each { chunks << _1 }; body.close if body.respond_to?(:close) }
    [status, headers, chunks]
  ensure
    current = nil
    request_thread = nil
    observations << {route: counts[:route], status: counts[:status], calls: counts[:calls].map { |key, count| {**methods.fetch(key), count: count} }.sort_by { -_1[:count] }}
    BmethodCensus.write(File.join(state, "requests.json"), observations)
  end
end
if mode == "fizzy"
  require "puma"
  server = Puma::Server.new(wrapped, nil, min_threads: 0, max_threads: 1)
  server.add_tcp_listener("127.0.0.1", 55439)
  puts "ready"
  $stdout.flush
  server.run.join
else
  require "rack/mock"
  session = Rack::MockRequest.new(wrapped)
  %w[cold warm warm_repeat].each do |phase|
    %w[/articles /articles/1].each do |path|
      response = session.get(path, "HTTP_HOST" => "localhost", "HTTPS" => "on")
      raise "#{phase} #{path}: #{response.status}" unless response.status == 200
    end
  end
end

      def revise(granted: [], revoked: [])
        transaction do
          grant_to granted
          revoke_from revoked
        end

        destroy_by user: users unless proxy_association.owner.all_access?

has_many :memberships, dependent: :delete_all do
    def grant_to(users)
      room = proxy_association.owner
      Membership.insert_all(Array(users).collect { |user| { room_id: room.id, user_id: user.id, involvement: room.default_involvement } })
    end

    def revoke_from(users)
      destroy_by user: users
    end

    def revise(granted: [], revoked: [])
      transaction do
        grant_to(granted) if granted.present?
        revoke_from(revoked) if revoked.present?
      end
    end
  end
